description: Run the project's own build script (npm/pnpm/yarn/bun run build; this runs the project's code), then check the output folder: how many copies of three are bundled and its size, assets the bundle or a .gltf refers to that are missing or differ in case, root-absolute URLs that break under a sub-path host such as GitHub Pages (with the base to set), Draco/KTX2 decoder files, then open the built page headless (served under its base). `build: false` checks the output that is already there. Use it before you call a page ready to deploy.

base.description: deploy base, e.g. "/repo/" for GitHub Pages (default from the config)

build.description: false: do not build, check the existing output

check.description: false: skip the headless check of the built page

out_dir.description: output folder (default from the bundler config, else dist, build or out)

path.description: Project folder, or a file or folder in it (relative to the server's folder; default: the project).

name: three_build
title: Build and check what will be deployed
